name: Skiff
intro: A six-track groovebox (14 synth and drum engines, 64-step sequencer, songs, PERFORM with scenes) where every page draws what its knobs do: pick a track with ALGORITHM, turn PRESETS, press PLAY - and hold HOME whenever you are lost.

rows.what: HOME: all six tracks at a glance; again: the scope.
SHIFT: map of what every control does here; let go: MENU.
Select track 1-6, on every page.
Previous / next page of the open family.
Quick layer: keys and knobs become shortcuts (also FX, SEL, EDIT, ARP, SEQ).
Lock a layer open; tap its button to close it.
Undo (8 levels); then OCT- further back, OCT+ redo.
Octave down (OCT+ up); both together: back to 0.
Next sound, across all engines; the track's steps stay.
SAVE > PRESETS: LIST one type (BASS, PAD ...) for PRESETS.
Switch the track to engine 1-14.
SCALE: ROOT, SCALE, QNT (WHITE: scale on white keys), TRN.
That key's note becomes the scale's ROOT.
Arpeggiator mode (14 modes); ARP 2 page: HOLD.
Momentary tweak: springs back on release (OCT+ keeps it).
On HOME: KNOB 1-4 are the engine's four main controls.
Engine pages EDIT 1 / 2, VOICE; FM6 OPERATOR, DRUM LANES.
ENV, then ENV DEST, ENV 2; tap for next.
LFO, LFO 2, LFO DEST, MOD (4-slot matrix).
INIT: start the sound from scratch (OCT+ confirms).
Start / stop.
Restart from the top without stopping.
Arm / disarm this track; stopped, it starts recording.
STEP tiles; tap for ROLL, CHANCE, PLAY, PATTERN, AUTOMATION, SONG.
Drum track: hit on / off; black keys 1-8 pick the lane.
Drum grid: lock a parameter on that step.
Tools: 1 CLEAR, 2 REVERSE, 5 RANDOM, 6 COOK, 8 EUCLID.
TAKE: keep the last loop you played, after the fact.
PERFORM: launch entry A-P; black keys 1-6 stage mutes.
Mute track 1-6 (white keys 1-6: solo while held).
Track sends; tap for DRIVE, INSERT, SLICER, DUCK.
Effect while held: REPEAT, REVERSE, filters, TAPE STOP, FREEZE ...
Cut track 1-6 while held.
Macros: FILTER (KNOB 2 CRUSH, 3 THROW, 4 DEPTH).
Throws: CUTOFF (2 REVERB, 3 DELAY, 4 DIST), glide back.
The buses: DELAY, then REVERB, CHORUS, GLOBAL.
Save the sound to a USER slot (stopped; keys type a name).
PROJECT page: SAVE to the slot on KNOB 1 (4 projects).
PROJECT page: LOAD the project on KNOB 1.
PRESETS page: right marks a favourite, left unmarks.
Tempo (white key 9 in the GLO layer: tap tempo).
MIXER: LEVEL, PAN, REVERB, MUTE of the selected track.
REC layer: white key 1 held clears; CLICK, COUNT-IN, FEEL.
FILL while held (plays the FILL steps).

tips: Nothing to save for the notes: patterns keep themselves, and RESTORE LAST brings the music back at power-on.
A sound loaded by PRESETS or the EDIT layer can be taken back with SAVE held; the track's steps never change.
Pages act on the selected track: watch the track number, ALGORITHM changes it everywhere.
On SAVE > PRESETS: KNOB 2 jumps to the next engine's first sound.
MENU (hold HOME, let go): ALGORITHM picks the tab, PRESETS the row, any KNOB the value; HOME closes it.
MENU > MIDI: CLOCK (INT, USB, TRS), a channel per track (1-6 by default), MIDI LEARN for any knob.
MENU > SYSTEM > CPU 2 CORES (BETA): 12 voices instead of 8, after a restart.
Hold OCT- and OCT+ for 5 seconds: UPDATE MODE for reinstalling (letting go earlier cancels). Held at power-on instead: HARDWARE CALIBRATION of the buttons and encoders.
checked: skiff-1.3.1 mirror, firmware/src/panel.c: B_SCL printed 'SEL', encoders SELECT / ALGORITHM / PRESETS / KNOB 1-4.

ui_input.c ui_input: HOME tap = go_home, on HOME toggles home_scope; HOME held = SHIFT map (ui.shift) and home_long -> MENU on release; SHIFT + SAVE = take_commit; SHIFT + layer button = layer_shift_lock; layer held + HOME = layer_home_lock; SAVE held = undo_step, OCT-/OCT+ in undo window; OCT both = 0, range +-3; ALGORITHM = track_select on every page; SELECT = select_turn (pages), GLO held = BPM; PLAY = play_press (GLO held: layer_play restart).
ui_input.c rec_tap: REC toggles song.rec on press; stopped and not on ROLL -> transport_req = 1 (starts); presets_turn: preset_step on HOME / most pages.
ui.c open_family / open_global: same button again = next page; GLO: MIXER then DELAY REVERB CHORUS GLOBAL; SAVE first time opens USER with ui.act = 4 (SAVE ready); home_param = ENGINES[..]->knob[k].

params.c PAGES: ENV/ENV DEST/ENV 2, LFO/LFO 2/LFO DEST/MOD, FX/DRIVE/INSERT/INSERT 2/SLICER/DUCK, SCALE/CHORD, EDIT 1/2 OPERATOR ALL OPS LANES SOUND SLICES VOICE VOICE 2, MIXER, DELAY REVERB CHORUS GLOBAL, PRESETS USER PATTERNS PROJECT, ARP/ARP 2, STEP ROLL CHANCE PLAY PATTERN AUTOMATION SONG; PROJECT knobs SLOT, -, LOAD, SAVE.

ui_layer.c LAYERS + layer_key/layer_knob: GLO black 1-6 mute, white 1-6 solo held, 7 unmute all, 8 FILL, 9 TAP; GLO knobs = levels; SCL key = ROOT; EDIT white 1-14 engines, 15 INIT dialog, black 1-8 drum lane mutes; PERF white = entries A-P / scenes, black 1-6 mute_switch staged, KNOB 1-4 throws, SELECT launch point; SEQ white = tools_key; REC layer only via SHIFT + REC.
ui_tools.c TL_ order F3 CLEAR, G3 REVERSE, A3/B3 SHIFT, C4 RANDOM, D4 COOK, E4 BEAT (drum), F4 EUCLID, ... D5 DOUBLE, E5 HALF.
perform.c: FX white keys F3..E5 = REPEAT 1/8 1/16 1/32, REVERSE, LPF, HPF, TAPE STOP, FREEZE, OCT UP, OCT DN, GATE, DUB, FLANGE, VINYL; black 1-6 track cut while held.
ui_input.c grid_keys / lock_held: drum STEP = grid, white keys steps, black 1-8 lane, 9 accent, 10/11 page; held white key + KNOB = lock_turn. mom_down / mom_turn: LFO held = momentary, OCT+ keeps.
ui_input.c act_do + ui_name.c: USER SAVE -> NAME screen, OCT+ writes, transport must be stopped; edit_param GR_BROWSE: KNOB 2 next engine, KNOB 3 preset_mark, KNOB 4 LIST.
main.c: OCT- + OCT+ at power-on -> panel_setup (calibration); held 5 s while running -> UPDATE MODE (fm1_enter_uboot), countdown from 2 s, release cancels.
unsure: SAVE tap opens the page it was left on (USER the first time), so the 'turn SELECT' to PRESETS / PROJECT depends on where SAVE was last; rows assume reaching that page.
REC from stopped: code starts the transport (count-in if set); on the ROLL page it enters step writing instead. Sheet simplifies to 'starts recording'.
Hold time is MENU > HOLD (300-600 ms, panel.c HOLD_MS), while the btn_hold comment says 0.7 s; not tried on hardware.
EDIT layer engine order on tracks 5/6 (no PHYS / GRAIN) shifts keys; INIT key is white 15 (F5) by LY_INIT = NENG_SHOWN. Not checked how eng_vis maps on T5/T6.
ui_layer.c struct comment says 'D4 held, FILL', but GLO_W maps FILL to white key 8 (F4) as README says; sheet follows GLO_W.
FX macro names FILTER/CRUSH/THROW/DEPTH and the throw names come from README + code comments (perf_k, throw_id), not from the draw strings.
